name: levitum
description: LEVITUM wiki tooling for Claude Code

plugins.name: leviwiki
plugins.description: The wiki-search skill (answer questions from the wiki), the wiki-builder skill (capture, and migration of many sources into many pages, splits and merges) with its wiki-cold-reader, wiki-coverage-checker and wiki-source-reader agents, the wiki-maintenance skill (issues, restructure), plus the hosted MCP gateway (search, read, publish to wiki.levitum.de)

mcp_url.title: MCP gateway URL
mcp_url.description: The gateway address ending in /mcp, e.g. https://<gateway-host>/mcp. The /enroll page shows it once you have saved a token
